title: Relationship Manager - Banking
summary: A banking relationship manager looks after a group of a bank's customers, from regular savers to wealthy (HNI) clients, growing their deposits and selling suitable investments and insurance. The role sits in a bank branch or priority banking team, reports to the branch or cluster head, and needs exam certificates to sell mutual funds and insurance.
dailyDuties: Call and meet mapped customers to review their accounts and investments
Open new savings, current and fixed deposit accounts with complete KYC
Pitch mutual funds, SIPs and insurance after risk profiling the customer
Cross-sell cards, loans and lockers to existing customers
Resolve customer requests with branch operations
Update leads and meetings in the CRM and track monthly targets

skills.expectation: Manage a mapped book of retail, affluent or HNI customers and grow their balances and AUM
Bring in new savings, current account and fixed deposit customers and grow CASA balances
Sell mutual funds, SIPs and insurance to customers as a certified distributor
Cross-sell cards, loans, lockers and other bank products to existing customers
Complete KYC and account-opening documents correctly and on time
Risk-profile customers and follow SEBI, AMFI and IRDAI rules so products suit them
Resolve customer service requests and complaints quickly with branch operations
Explain products clearly to customers and hold regular portfolio review meetings
Log leads, calls and customer meetings in the bank's CRM
Understand retail banking products, rates and charges
Keep customers from closing accounts and win back lost balances
Track targets, balances and pipeline in a spreadsheet
